Job Description:
 Operations Tech Developer (Python / React) 
 
 Jain Global, LLC  
 
 Jain Global is an innovative multi-strategy investment firm founded in July 2024 by Bobby Jain with over 400 employees operating from offices in New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong, we are looking to add to our growing teams.   
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Build and maintain full stack applications using React and Python

 Develop APIs and backend services

 Work with databases and data platforms including Snowflake and AWS RDS

 Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to solve business problems

 Debug and optimize systems across frontend, backend, and data layers

 Write clean, scalable, and well-tested code

 Take ownership of projects and deliver features end-to-end

 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 Strong foundation in Python, React / TypeScript, REST APIs, and SQL

 Familiarity with Snowflake, AWS RDS / Postgres / MySQL, Git and modern development workflows

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 Curious mindset with a willingness to learn quickly

 High work ethic and attention to detail

 Exposure to AWS or cloud infrastructure preferred, but not required

 Experience with Docker or CI/CD pipelines preferred, but not required

 Interest in AI/LLMs or data engineering preferred, but not required

 
 Compensation 
 Jain Global offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $180,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package. 
 
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer 
 As an employer, we believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of Jain Global teams to drive competitive performance. We believe an inclusive environment can yield exceptional contributions.
